recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a man in a pinstriped blazer against a soft-focus forest background, overlaid with translucent vintage document textures and a rough, hand-drawn double-line border.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with head in the upper third
Translucent historical document overlaying the lower two-thirds of the image
Large distressed serif text layered over the subject's torso
Hand-drawn ink border framing the entire composition
coreInvariants: Warm, golden-hour lighting with high-key background bokeh
Distressed, weathered texture applied to all typographic elements
Double-line sketch border with uneven corners

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, centered, subject facing slightly to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large white display text at the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's face down to the large serif name, then following the script subtitle to the right, finally exploring the background document details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Soft-focus foliage in the upper corners provides breathing room above the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm earth tones (browns, greens, and golden yellows) in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy and white pinstripes on the blazer.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for the primary typography to ensure legibility against dark clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the overlays to mimic aged paper; high value in the background bokeh.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Sturdy slab-serif and elegant copperplate script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick, uneven strokes with visible distressing and 'ink-bleed' edges
Secondary text uses a fluid, connected script with high stroke contrast
Background text uses a typewriter or ledger-style monospaced font at low opacity
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' in the primary name features an elongated, slightly curved descender
Script letters have extended flourishes on the start and end characters

composition.position: Below and to the right of display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, rugged slab serif paired with a delicate, refined script to balance masculinity and elegance.

preserve: The distressed texture of the main font
The layering of text over the subject

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary slab-serif weight and historical feel.
Matches the elegant, high-contrast script style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a pinstriped navy blazer standing in a sun-dappled forest with hanging moss. Overlay a semi-transparent vintage 1870s handwritten ledger document across the bottom half. Add a hand-drawn, slightly messy double-line black ink border around the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a large, white, distressed slab-serif font in the center. Add a secondary title in a white elegant script font, positioned slightly below and to the right of the main name.

verificationChecks: Is the document overlay translucent enough to see the subject through it?
Does the border look hand-drawn rather than digitally perfect?
Is the main text sufficiently distressed to look like old woodblock printing?
Is the lighting warm and golden?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distressing on the typography

avoid: Plastic or overly smooth digital finishes

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script text doesn't get lost in the document texture
Check that the subject's face remains the primary focal point
Verify the border lines overlap at the corners in a sketch-like manner
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered outdoor portrait with a historical document overlay, framed by a sketch border and anchored by high-contrast, distressed serif and script typography.
